_comment: AA-855: the one UAT scenario catalogue (plan docs/audits/2026-11-05-S268-video-plan, OPS structure). One row per scenario id; tools/uat/lib/catalogue.cjs validates it and tools/uat/tests/catalogue.test.cjs ties it to the scenario files and the dry-run manifest. status: live (recordable now), after-lane (waits on a code lane), blocked (external dependency), retired (kept, never reused). round: the UAT round a row is recorded in (R<k>-<yyyy-mm>). Public repo: no Drive links, account ids, prices or real tenant names here.
